questions_for_advisor: The run gate (_RunGate) is process state: with more than one uvicorn worker the cap would be per-worker rather than global. Single-process is the documented deployment; is a cross-worker cap worth a real store, or does the ruling's 'at most max_concurrent_runs' stand as per-process with the README saying so?

A retried chat call (429 backoff, or the response_format retry) reserves ONE worst case for the whole call although each attempt is dispatched. Actual cost of every attempt is booked on success; the reservation covers one dispatch's worst case. Should a retried call reserve per attempt, or is one-call-one-reservation the intended unit?
